original_thesis.name: Daily / multi-year context
original_thesis.role: Macro and multi-day trend/volatility/volume context filtering to identify interesting candidates before market open or during session preparation; candidate qualification rather than direct entry trigger.

original_thesis.name: 133-tick structure
original_thesis.role: Intermediate intraday market structure characterization using activity-driven volume bars rather than fixed clock intervals; establishes intraday structural trend, swings, and support/resistance zones.

original_thesis.name: 1-minute setup context
original_thesis.role: Concrete chart setup pattern identification in calendar time (e.g. consolidation, pullback, breakout pattern, VWAP relationship) conditioned on upstream Daily and 133-tick alignment.

original_thesis.name: 50-tick entry timing
original_thesis.role: High-resolution micro-structure confirmation and precision entry timing; fires only when upstream layers are fully satisfied.

original_thesis.name: Trigger / entry / invalidation / exit
original_thesis.role: Deterministic trade lifecycle management defining entry fill price, protective stop loss, profit target, trailing logic, maximum duration, session-end liquidation, and realistic slippage/fees.

major_gaps.title: Raw trade-tick acquisition and provider contract absence
major_gaps.description: TradeX currently possesses zero provider clients, fetchers, or storage pipelines for historical trade ticks. Existing fetchers (tradex/data/fetcher.py and tradex/research/intraday_dataset/alpaca_client.py) support only daily or fixed-time minute bars (/v2/stocks/bars). No tick-level acquisition (/v2/stocks/trades) exists.

major_gaps.title: Tick-bar aggregation engine and deterministic storage foundation
major_gaps.description: Zero runtime logic exists to aggregate raw execution trades into 133-tick or 50-tick CompletedBar sequences. No storage format (Parquet/database), session-reset rules, trade qualification filters, or timestamp convention policies exist in code.

major_gaps.title: Cross-resolution PIT synchronization and availability contract
major_gaps.description: MultiResolutionSeries.filter_as_of() in tradex/research/daytrade_mvp/models.py provides pure in-memory timestamp filtering (bar.timestamp <= as_of), but lacks source-specific availability metadata (available_at vs bar_start), daily-session closure awareness, and real-time SIP delay modeling.

major_gaps.title: Concrete Gary strategy rule elicitation and preregistration lock
major_gaps.description: The repository currently contains only an illustrative synthetic setup (SYNTH-DAYTRADE-001 in tradex/research/daytrade_mvp/synthetic.py). Gary's actual discretionary rules for Daily context, 133-tick trend, 1-minute setup, 50-tick trigger, stops, and targets have never been formally elicited or preregistered.

major_gaps.title: Full-lifecycle trade execution simulator and path-dependent outcome engine
major_gaps.description: Existing intraday research evaluators (tradex/research/daytrade_reversal and tradex/research/daytrade_momentum) are fixed-horizon event studies (1m, 2m, 5m, 30m). They do not simulate path-dependent trade execution (first-touch between stop and target, trailing stops, MFE/MAE, or trade concurrency limits).

existing_capabilities.evidence: Resolution enum (DAILY, TICK_133, MINUTE_1, TICK_50); CompletedBar immutable dataclass with aware datetimes, OHLCV, and bar_start; MultiResolutionSeries container supporting all 4 resolutions and isolated as-of filtering.
DaytradeSetup abstract protocol requiring setup_id, version, required_resolutions; evaluate_setup() enforces fail-closed INVALID_INPUT on missing resolutions and materializes isolated PIT series.

SYNTH_DAYTRADE_001 smoke setup; generate_synthetic_multi_res_data() generates deterministic 4-resolution series with future bars; 9 passing tests verify zero future leakage and fail-closed invariants.
Multi-provider daily history via Schwab, Alpaca, Yahoo, IBKR; normalized UTC DataFrame with open, high, low, close, volume; FetchPolicy with retry and fallback.

existing_capabilities.component: Point-in-time reference and corporate action data
existing_capabilities.evidence: Schema v8 PIT store with prospective reference and earnings capture; Massive/Polygon ticker classification; exact ticker matching; universe drift guards.
Session-clustered joint bootstrap algorithm (2,000 replications); matched non-event baseline comparisons; strict 5-step disposition precedence; split boundary protection.

missing_capabilities.notes: No TradeX client requests /v2/stocks/trades or raw ticks from Alpaca, Schwab, IBKR, or Polygon.
No websocket client, event loop, or real-time trade receiver exists in TradeX.
No logic exists to group raw trades into N-tick OHLCV bars, track volume, or emit CompletedBar objects.

missing_capabilities.capability: Historical trade-tick and tick-bar storage layout
missing_capabilities.notes: No database schema, Parquet directory structure, or serialization format exists for tick data.
No rules implemented for odd lots, dark pool prints, Form T, trade condition codes, or corrections/cancellations.
No mechanism exists to reset tick accumulators at 09:30:00 ET or handle partial bars at 16:00:00 ET.
No domain model or extractor exists to transform daily bars into standardized daily context variables (trend, ATR, levels).
Existing evaluators are fixed-horizon event studies; no simulator tracks path-dependent stop/target hits or MFE/MAE.

missing_capabilities.capability: Gary Yang's actual day-trading strategy specification
missing_capabilities.notes: Only synthetic demonstration rules exist; real discretionary rules have never been documented or approved.

unknown_capabilities.item: Alpaca SIP historical trade-tick rate limits and pagination capacity
unknown_capabilities.notes: Unknown whether Alpaca's /v2/stocks/trades endpoint can satisfy high-volume multi-symbol tick downloads without timeout/rate-limit failure within reasonable research budgets. Must be tested via a bounded provider study in DAYTRADE-003B.

unknown_capabilities.item: Alpaca trade condition codes and odd-lot filtering flags
unknown_capabilities.notes: Unknown whether Alpaca SIP trades include full consolidated tape condition flags (e.g. ISO, average price, derivatively priced, late) to allow clean tick filtering.

unknown_capabilities.item: Historical trade cancellation / correction frequency in provider feeds
unknown_capabilities.notes: Unknown how trade corrections and cancellations are surfaced in historical vs streaming tick feeds.

unknown_capabilities.item: Storage footprint and IO performance of multi-symbol tick-bar databases
unknown_capabilities.notes: Unknown disk footprint and read latency for 133-tick and 50-tick bars across a 30-50 symbol universe over 1-2 years.

policy_decisions_required.decision: What constitutes a single trade/tick for 50-tick and 133-tick bar counting?
options: Every consolidated tape print regardless of size or condition
Every regular-sale trade excluding odd lots (<100 shares)
Every print with volume > 0, filtering out specified out-of-sequence condition codes

policy_decisions_required.decision: How do tick counters behave across session boundaries (09:30 and 16:00 ET)?
options: Reset bar accumulator fresh at 09:30:00 ET every regular session (Standard)
Carry forward incomplete bar trade count from previous session
Include premarket trades in the opening bar

policy_decisions_required.decision: How is a partially completed tick bar handled at the 16:00:00 regular session close?
options: Discard incomplete bar (only fully completed 50/133 trade bars are evaluated)
Emit marked partial bar with final trade at 16:00:00

policy_decisions_required.decision: What timestamp is assigned to CompletedBar for tick bars?
options: Timestamp of the final constituent trade (completion timestamp) as primary timestamp, with first trade as bar_start
Timestamp of the first trade as primary timestamp
SIP receipt timestamp rather than participant exchange timestamp

policy_decisions_required.decision: Are pre-market and after-hours trades included in tick-bar construction?
options: Strict regular market hours only (09:30:00 to 16:00:00 ET)
Separate pre-market tick bars constructed for session preparation

policy_decisions_required.decision: How are raw trade prices adjusted for historical stock splits?
options: Raw trade prices stored; split factors applied dynamically at bar aggregation or read time
Pre-split raw trade files; historical tick bars rebuilt upon corporate action

data_feasibility_questions: Does our licensed Alpaca data subscription include historical SIP trade-level ticks (/v2/stocks/trades)?
What is the request latency, page limit, and throttling behavior when fetching 1 full trading day of trades for an active equity (e.g. AAPL, NVDA)?
What fields are returned in each trade record (t, x, p, s, c, z), and do they include exchange timestamp vs participant timestamp?
How many trades occur per day on average across candidate universe members (e.g., Dow 30 vs Sector ETFs)?
How many 133-tick and 50-tick bars does a typical trading session generate for high-liquidity vs medium-liquidity securities?
Can a single underlying trade dataset be efficiently cached and queried to produce both 133-tick and 50-tick bars simultaneously?

strategy_inputs_requiring_gary_definitio.questions: What technical or fundamental factors make a security eligible for day trading? E.g., moving average trend (EMA 20, SMA 50), ATR minimum, multi-day coil/compression, relative volume buildup, earnings proximity, or sector relative strength?

What exact market structure must the 133-tick chart display before a setup can be considered? E.g., higher highs and higher lows, breakout from 133-tick consolidation range, VWAP slope/position, or 133-tick moving average cross?
What specific chart setup pattern must form on the 1-minute chart? E.g., bull flag, pullback to 1-min 20 EMA, VWAP reclaim, opening range breakout, or volume compression?

What precise micro-structure event on the 50-tick chart authorizes entry? E.g., 50-tick close breaking local micro-resistance, micro-double bottom breakout, micro-volume spike, or consecutive advancing tick bars?

Direction (Long only, Short only, or Bidirectional)? Order type (Market on 50-tick bar completion, Limit at breakout price, or Stop-market above bar high)? Execution fill price convention and slippage allowance?
What is the exact, deterministic stop-loss rule known at entry? E.g., low of the 50-tick trigger bar, lowest swing low of the 1-minute setup, fixed tick distance, or ATR fraction?
What are the profit target and exit rules? E.g., fixed R-multiple (1R, 2R), prior 133-tick resistance level, trailing stop logic, or partial scale-outs?
Maximum position duration before time exit? Intraday forced liquidation time (e.g. 15:55 or 15:59 ET)? Strict prohibition against holding overnight? Maximum concurrent positions?

What conditions explicitly suppress trading? E.g., time-of-day restrictions (first 15 minutes 09:30-09:45 ET, lunch 12:00-13:00 ET, last 30 minutes), major economic releases (FOMC, CPI), wide bid-ask spread, or low tick velocity?
What specific human-readable reasons and quantitative evidence values must TradeX display in the decision-support UI for Gary to understand why a setup triggered?

reusable_components.component: Resolution enum, CompletedBar, MultiResolutionSeries, DaytradeSetup, evaluate_setup()
reusable_components.justification: Provides a clean, verified, tested in-memory multi-resolution foundation with fail-closed checks and PIT filtering.
Proves deterministic coexistence, future-data isolation, and zero-provider execution.

reusable_components.component: Pre-registration protocol and machine-readable specification locking
reusable_components.justification: Eliminates post-hoc parameter fishing and enforces research integrity.

reusable_components.component: Session-clustered bootstrap inference and matched baseline uplift
reusable_components.justification: Accounts for market co-movement, cross-sectional clustering, and baseline joint sampling uncertainty.

reusable_components.component: Data-quality auditing framework and split boundary isolation
reusable_components.justification: Deterministic tracking of missing bars, duplicates, and strict chronological partition guards.

reusable_components.component: Centralized runtime configuration and strategy authorization registry
reusable_components.justification: Enforces credential safety, test isolation, and keeps APPROVED_PRODUCTION_STRATEGIES strictly empty.

components_not_to_reuse.reason: Empirically rejected in development; isolated 1-minute micro-reversal anomaly, not a multi-resolution setup.

components_not_to_reuse.component: DAYTRADE-002 5.5-hour information gap ETF momentum rules
components_not_to_reuse.reason: Specifically designed for end-of-day ETF rebalancing flow; does not utilize 133-tick, 1-minute, or 50-tick multi-resolution hierarchy.

components_not_to_reuse.component: INTRA-001 opening-drive / VWAP pullback continuation rules
components_not_to_reuse.reason: Hardcoded 5-minute calendar grid; inconclusive hypothesis with insufficient sample size; not a general day-trading primitive.
Arbitrary 0-100 indicator heuristics with no execution rules, transaction friction, or point-in-time validation.

components_not_to_reuse.component: Binary-only research disposition gate (Step 2 & Step 4 hard failure)
components_not_to_reuse.reason: Binary gate mechanically discarded studies with positive edge due to minor ticker data-quality flaws or CI crossing zero; multi-resolution needs a nuanced taxonomy separating research continuation from production promotion.

recommended_sequence.title: Original multi-resolution thesis re-anchor and gap analysis
recommended_sequence.scope: Documentation and gap matrix only; no code changes, no provider calls, no empirical tests.

recommended_sequence.title: Tick-data provider & data-feasibility study
recommended_sequence.scope: Bounded empirical probe evaluating Alpaca (or alternative) raw trade-tick endpoints, pagination, latency, and data completeness. Zero strategy backtests.

recommended_sequence.title: Tick-bar deterministic aggregation engine & storage foundation
recommended_sequence.scope: Implement offline and streaming trade accumulators producing 133-tick and 50-tick CompletedBar series from raw trade streams; lock session boundaries, trade condition filters, and storage schema.

recommended_sequence.title: Gary multi-resolution strategy elicitation & preregistration specification
recommended_sequence.scope: Structured strategy interview with Gary Yang locking concrete rules for Daily context, 133-tick structure, 1-min setup, 50-tick trigger, stops, targets, and no-trade conditions.

recommended_sequence.title: Synthetic full-lifecycle trade simulator & multi-resolution evaluator
recommended_sequence.scope: Build full trade execution simulator modeling entry fills, path-dependent stop/target hits, trailing stops, MFE/MAE, transaction friction, and concurrency. Validate on synthetic fixtures.

recommended_sequence.title: Bounded empirical development study
recommended_sequence.scope: Execute locked multi-resolution strategy on historical development partition of real tick data; analyze execution distributions, baseline uplift, and parameter stability.

recommended_sequence.title: Formal validation study
recommended_sequence.scope: One-pass preregistered validation evaluation on untouched out-of-sample partition under the multi-state disposition taxonomy.

recommended_sequence.title: Conditional holdout and prospective shadow evaluation
recommended_sequence.scope: Holdout unsealed only if validation passes; prospective shadow paper trading before any production decision-support consideration.
